**Severity:** error · **Area:** Resume (`RV2xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
JSX inside handlers, effects and computeds is not resumable
```

## How to fix

Keep JSX in the render: store data in a signal from the handler and render it with `{() => …}` / `<Show>`.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
import { signal } from "@rivetjs/reactivity";
export function A() { const s = signal<any>(null); return <button onClick={() => s.set(<p />)} />; }
```

```tsx prefer
import { signal } from "@rivetjs/reactivity";
export function A() { const on = signal(false); return <div><button onClick={() => on.set(true)} />{() => (on() ? <p /> : null)}</div>; }
```

## When it is reported

Resume mode.
